name: Daisy Links – Check broken links, add nofollow attributes, open links in new tabs
author: DaisyPlugins

sections.description:
Daisy Links is a powerful WordPress plugin designed to help you manage links on your website with ease. Whether you want to check for broken links, add nofollow attributes, open links in new tabs, or view all external links with their statuses, Daisy Links has got you covered!

Features

🌼 Check Broken Links

  • Detect and flag broken external links.

🌼 Add Nofollow Attributes

  • Easily add rel="nofollow" to all external links with a single toggle.
  • Improve your website’s SEO by controlling link equity.

🌼 Open Links in New Tab

  • Enable a global setting to open all external links in new tabs.
  • Enhance user experience by keeping visitors on your site.

🌼 View External Links with Status

  • See a comprehensive list of all external links on your website.
  • Check and access their locations (post/page) at a glance.
  • View the status of each link (Active or Broken).

Usage 🖱️

  1. Global Settings:

    • Go to Settings > Global Settings.
    • Toggle the options for adding nofollow attributes and opening links in new tabs.
    • Click Save Changes.

  2. External Links:

    • Go to Settings > External Links.
    • View all external links, their locations, and statuses.
    • Identify and fix broken links.

Support & Feedback 💬

If you have any questions, issues, or feature requests, feel free to reach out:
– Email: support@daisyplugins.com
– Support Forum: Daisy Links Support
– GitHub Issues: Report an Issue

Contribute 🤝

We welcome contributions! If you’d like to contribute to Daisy Links, please:
1. Fork the repository on GitHub.
2. Create a new branch for your feature or bug fix.
3. Submit a pull request.

License 📜

Daisy Links is licensed under the GPLv2. Feel free to use, modify, and distribute it as per the license terms.

Thank You! ❤️

Thank you for choosing Daisy Links! We hope this plugin makes managing your external links a breeze. If you love Daisy Links, consider leaving a ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ review on the WordPress Plugin Repository.
sections.installation:
Installation from within WordPress

  1. Visit Plugins > Add New.
  2. Search for Daisy Links.
  3. Install and activate the Daisy Links plugin.

Manual installation

  1. Upload the entire daisy-links folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Visit Plugins.
  3. Activate the Daisy Links plugin.
sections.faq:
How to install and activate Daisy Links?

  1. Download the daisy-links.zip file from the WordPress plugin repository or your source.
  2. Go to your WordPress admin dashboard.
  3. Navigate to Plugins > Add New > Upload Plugin.
  4. Upload the daisy-links.zip file and click Install Now.
  5. Once installed, click Activate Plugin.

What if the plugin reports something that’s correct as an “error” or “warning”?

We strive to write a plugin in a way that minimizes false positives but if you find one, please open an issue in the community forum. For certain false positives, such as those detected by PHPCodeSniffer, you may be able to annotate the code to ignore the specific problem for a specific line.
